questions.stem:
What does this C code print?

```c
printf("%d", 17 / 5);
```
questions.explain: Both operands are ints, so C does integer division and drops the remainder: 17 / 5 = 3.
x becomes 5 + 2 = 7. Then y = x − y uses the new x, so y = 7 − 2 = 5. It prints 7 5.
The loop adds the squares 1, 4, 9 and 16, so s = 30.
The inner call f(2) returns 5. Then f(5) returns 5 × 2 + 1 = 11.
The inner loop runs 4, 3, 2 and 1 times as i goes from 0 to 3, so c = 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 10.
